entities.summary: Archduke Wilhelm Franz of Austria, later known as Wilhelm Franz von Habsburg-Lothringen, and also referred to as Vasyl Vyshyvanyi, was an Austrian archduke, a colonel in the Ukrainian Sich Riflemen, a poet, and a member of the House of Habsburg-Lorraine.
